text:
Greetings ramp team,
Thanks for a patient run; the front-counter lead discussed a thought on pet arrivals

I wanted to pass along a calm reminder for the next wave at Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping the handoff process steady, and a little extra notice at the gate helps us keep pets settled and travelers reassured. Please stay gentle with carriers, speak softly around nervous animals, and flag anything that looks out of step so we can sort it early.

<<FACT F049>> We appreciate how smoothly the crew keeps things moving when the paperwork is ready and the pet is matched to the right path. That kind of care makes a real difference for families traveling with companions.

<<FACT F040>> <<FACT F031>> Please keep sharing those quick updates, since they help us protect animal comfort without slowing the whole operation. Thanks for staying attentive and kind with every pet that comes through. Companions Travel Desk, Aurelia Skyways
